text.body: śrī gaṇeśāya namaḥ । caturmukhādisaṃstutaṃ samastasātvatānutam । halāyudhādisaṃyutaṃ namāmi rādhikādhipam ॥ 1॥ bakādidaityakālakaṃ sagopagopipālakam । manoharāsitālakaṃ namāmi rādhikādhipam ॥ 2॥ surendragarvagañjanaṃ virañcimohabhañjanam । vrajāṅganānurañjanaṃ namāmi rādhikādhipam ॥ 3॥ mayūrapicchamaṇḍanaṃ gajendradantakhaṇḍanam । nṛśaṃsakaṃsadaṇḍanaṃ namāmi rādhikādhipam ॥ 4॥ pradattavipradārakaṃ sudāmadhāmakārakam । suradrumāpahārakaṃ namāmi rādhikādhipam ॥ 5॥ dhanañjayājayāvahaṃ mahācamūkṣayāvaham । pitāmahavyathāpahaṃ namāmi rādhikādhipam ॥ 6॥ munīndraśāpakāraṇaṃ yaduprajāpahāraṇam । dharābharāvatāraṇaṃ namāmi rādhikādhipam ॥ 7॥ suvṛkṣamūlaśāyinaṃ mṛgārimokṣadāyinam । svakīyadhāmamāyinaṃ namāmi rādhikādhipam ॥ 8॥ idaṃ samāhito hitaṃ varāṣṭakaṃ sadā mudā । japañjano janurjarādito drutaṃ pramucyate ॥ 9॥ ॥ iti śrīparamahaṃsabrahmānandaviracitaṃ śrīkṛṣṇāṣṭakaṃ sampūrṇam ॥
